Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber is a cybersecurity focused variant of Gemini 3.8 Flash, built for vulnerability detection and automated patching. It exceeds 70 percent success on internal vulnerability discovery evaluations spanning 20 programming languages and reaches 47.2 percent pass at 1 on the CWE Bench patching benchmark. In Chrome testing it produced 2.6 times more correct patches than the best evaluated commercial models. Access is limited to vetted defenders through the Fairwind Program.

Gemini 3.8 Flash is a multimodal model in the Gemini 3 family, built for long horizon software engineering, autonomous agents and complex enterprise workflows. It accepts text, image, audio and video input and returns text, with a context window of up to 1M tokens and up to 64K output tokens. An adjustable effort setting trades response quality against cost and latency. Knowledge cutoff is March 2026. Access is through the Gemini API, Google AI Studio and the Gemini app.

Quasar 438B is a 438 billion parameter text only large language model built for reasoning. Extended thinking is always on, with a reasoning effort setting that controls depth. It works in English and Spanish, supports function and tool calling plus structured outputs, and targets agentic coding, software engineering, operational automation and long context document research. It is served through a hosted API as a proprietary model, with weights not released.

Qwen3.8-Max-0902 is an upgraded snapshot of Qwen3.8-Max. It accepts text, image and video input and returns text, with a 1M token context window, up to 128K output tokens and an optional thinking mode carrying up to 256K chain-of-thought tokens. The 0902 update focuses on coding for engineering-scale projects and long-horizon autonomous development, multi-tool agent orchestration, and native vision understanding across chart reasoning, document parsing and multimodal perception.

Visko Orbis 1.0 is a real time video generation model that streams long form video and lets the prompt be changed while generation is in progress, with the update becoming visible during the stream. It supports text to video, image to video, and video continuation, accepts multilingual prompts, and uses a bounded multi scale memory to hold subjects, scenes, and style steady across hour scale runs. A distilled chunk wise streaming generator and a streaming upscaler deliver 4K output at 24 FPS.

Claude Mythos 5.1 is a closed source large language model that takes text and image input and returns text. It is functionally identical to Claude Fable 5.1 but ships with more permissive safeguards for vetted users, and is available by invitation only. It has a 1M token context window and a 128K token maximum output. Extended thinking is adaptive and always on, with a default effort level of high. It supports tool use and function calling. Training data cutoff is June 2026.

Claude Fable 5.1 is a closed source large language model that takes text and image input and returns text. It has a 1M token context window and a 128K token maximum output. Extended thinking is adaptive and always on, with a default effort level of high. It supports tool use and function calling, and targets agentic coding, code review, terminal based development, computer use and long running multi step problem solving. Training data cutoff is June 2026.

Heaviside 1 is a 350M parameter foundation model for electromagnetics. It takes fully 3D structures together with material properties and excitation patterns and predicts electric (E) and magnetic (H) near fields at arbitrary locations, from which quantities such as S parameters follow. It was trained on 250k unique 3D designs covering 500B field samples and runs about 10^5 times faster than commercial solvers while staying within 1 dB of them.

Muse Voice Transcribe is a real time audio perception model that performs streaming speech recognition, speaker diarization and endpointing in a single pass. It ingests audio in 80 millisecond chunks, each turned into one soft token, and handles audio beyond one hour with 20 or more speakers without post processing. It covers 70 or more languages, 25 extensively verified, with native code switching. It reports a 3.1 percent word error rate and a 17.5 percent diarization error rate.

Atlas is an omni world model for spatial intelligence, built as a multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer. It natively operates on text, images, camera poses and 3D depth maps, and can generate, reconstruct and simulate worlds. Outputs include images and video up to one minute at 1440p, novel views from specified camera positions, 360 degree panoramas, depth maps, and worlds as point clouds or 3D Gaussian splats. It can reconstruct a scene from as few as one to three input images.

pplx pii masking is a 0.6B parameter bidirectional text encoder that detects and masks personally identifiable information in conversational data. It performs token level classification across 9 PII categories using a BIOES tagging scheme and produces a conversation level sensitivity score. Maximum sequence length is 4096 tokens. It is small enough to run locally, so text can be screened and sensitive spans replaced with placeholders before data is sent elsewhere. MIT licensed.

Solaris is a real time interactive world model that generates video frame by frame in response to user input. It takes text prompts and images as conditioning and treats interactions such as clicks, drags and typing as conditioning for the next frame, so an on screen interface responds continuously as it is used. It renders at 720p and is built on the Gen 4.5 video model, using autoregressive frame generation with few denoising steps to stay within interactive latency.

TimesFM 3 is a 330M parameter decoder-only transformer for time series forecasting. It is natively pre-trained for multivariate forecasting, jointly predicting multiple coevolving series and accepting past covariates and past-future dynamic covariates. It returns point forecasts plus nine quantiles (10th to 90th percentile) for every target and generates the entire forecast horizon in a single forward pass, operating zero-shot with no task-specific fine-tuning.

Phonon 1 is an open speech recognition model for English. It downloads in 415 MB and runs on a laptop or a datacenter GPU, transcribing an hour of audio in about two and a half minutes. It was trained at 2.4 bits per weight from the start, making it a low bit, on device capable transcription model built on a quantized Qwen3 ASR base.

Hy4 preview GGUF is Tencent's quantized release of the Hy4 preview Mixture-of-Experts language model, packaged as two llama.cpp compatible files. The Q4_K_M build is a standard 4 bit quantization at 4.86 bits per weight. The STQ1_0 build uses an imatrix aware mixed precision ternary encoding to reach 2.38 bits per weight, roughly half the size, using a weighted least squares scale and imatrix guided zero placement to preserve accuracy at very low bit widths.
